title: Interactive ward unregister for this checkout binding
description: DEC-217 / ODOC-488 step 2b: interactive trusted-terminal command removing this checkout binding only; removes its profile approvals only after a second confirmation. Refuses when unbound; never touches another root binding. Supersedes the ADR 0005 no-unregister statement.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ward unregister removes only the current checkout binding
Its profile approvals are removed only after a second confirmation
It refuses when the checkout is not bound and in a non-interactive terminal
Registered in ward manifest --json and help

implementationNotes: Built per DEC-217 Q4, recorded as ADR 0022 (ADR 0005 marked superseded in part). For review: declining the second question keeps approvals, and registering the same directory again revives them until expiry or revoke; DEC-217 does not say, and the report states it. It is admin in the manifest and needs no manifest file. Stacked on WCLI-72, itself on WCLI-12 (opum-ai/ward-cli#149); no PR until those land.

opum-doc verdict on #154 at 191b7f28 (reviewer opum-doc, claude-opus-5-5): APPROVE with one required fix and lows. Required: approvals are matched by projectId as well as root, device and inode (DEC-217 Q4), with a test. Lows: docs/log.md stale 4461060 entry replaced; ADR 0022 context no longer claims a moved checkout is freed; tests for symlink, moved and worktree. Judgement: revival after declining is not a security defect (needs interactive re-registration, expiry 24h or less); dropping ADR 0007 from the verification profile only is accepted. All done in the follow-up commit; the new projectId test is red against the old filter.
finalSummary: Landed as opum-ai/ward-cli#154 (1142ac1). ward unregister removes this checkout binding (path, device, inode) on one confirmation and that binding approvals (matched by projectId too) on a second; refused without a terminal or when not bound; grants untouched. Declining the second question keeps approvals and re-registering the same directory revives them until expiry (opum-doc: not a security defect). ADR 0022; ADR 0005 amended. opum-doc APPROVE at 191b7f28 with one required fix (projectId match) and lows, scoped re-look APPROVE at 0e33700b. verification agent profile narrowed by ADR 0007, budget not raised.
